name: pulse
description: Pulse - Website & API uptime monitoring platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,notify,web -c blue,yellow,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @pulse/api" "npm run worker -w @pulse/api" "npm run notification-worker -w @pulse/api" "npm run dev -w @pulse/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pulse/api && npm run build -w @pulse/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pulse/shared && npm run typecheck -w @pulse/api && npm run typecheck -w @pulse/web
